english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the act of running or going jogging.

exampleSentences.english: I went for a run this morning for half an hour.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我朝早跑步跑咗半個鐘。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 paau2 bou6 paau2 zo2 bun3 go3 zung1

english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for physical running, including running as exercise.

exampleSentences.english: I like running in the morning as exercise.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我朝早鍾意跑步，當做運動。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 zung1 ji3 paau2 bou6 dong1 zou6 wan6 dung6
